method: numerical search of this atlas: orbit elimination with code/sym_elim.py for the subgroup C3 (moment equations reduced to the C3-invariant subspace), in several stages of 2400 s, started from the rule CA-T3-35-2352-PI-WHZ; nodes kept in the closed domain; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz

reproduce.command: mkdir -p out35 && python3 -c "import json,numpy as np;r=json.load(open('rules/worku_hicken_zingg_2024/tetra/CA-T3-35-2352-PI-WHZ.json'));np.save('out35/start.npy',np.c_[np.array(r['nodes']),np.array(r['weights'])])" && cd code && stages (group:seed) in this order: c3:8401,c3:8402,c3:8601,c3:8602,c3:8603,c3:8605,c3:8606,c3:8607,c3:8608,c3:8609,c3:8610,c3:8611,c3:8612; each stage starts from the smallest rule written by the stage before in ../out35 (the first from ../out35/start.npy): MI=40 NCAND=8 EXTTOL=1e-5 EXTIT=150 python3 sym_elim.py <group> 35 2400 <seed> <start> --out ../out35
